name: Los Angeles Dodgers
description: One of baseball's most storied franchises. The 2024 World Series champions boast a roster of superstars, a legendary ballpark, and a passionate fanbase spanning generations.

name: New York Yankees
description: The most decorated franchise in American sports. With 27 World Series titles and an iconic pinstripe uniform, the Yankees represent the standard every team chases.

name: Atlanta Braves
description: Back-to-back NL East dominators with a deep farm system and a culture of winning. The 2021 World Series champions built around elite young talent and veteran leadership.

name: Houston Astros
description: A dynasty built on analytics and pitching development. The Astros have reached the World Series four times since 2017, cementing their place among baseball's elite.

name: New York Mets
description: The 2024 Wild Card darlings who stunned the baseball world with an improbable playoff run. With Juan Soto and Francisco Lindor, the Mets are built for years to come.

name: Chicago Cubs
description: One of baseball's most iconic franchises, playing in the beloved Wrigley Field since 1914. The 2016 championship ended a 108-year drought in one of sports' greatest moments.
